_about: Reviewed corrections to the largest lake of a region. 'excludeItems' lists Wikidata items with a wrong area, former lakes, salt flats and sea lagoons, so that the next lake is used. 'skipFactbook' lists Factbook entries that are sea lagoons. A region key holds a replacement lake, or null when the region has no lake.
